# hardware-for-anything

> AI-agnostic, reusable hardware (PCB) design template in Turkish: Manager / Designer / Reviewer roles, user approval gates (G0, G0.5, G1), quality profiles (Hobby / Industrial / Aerospace), optional RF, battery and avionics rules, output naming like DR00627-R01, and a dependency-free Python checker. Start with AGENTS.md; do not read every rule file.

## Start here
- Run `python scripts/projectctl.py next` (or ask the user to run it) to see the next missing step and its command.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/AGENTS.md): How an AI should work with this repo; section "Repo linkiyle başlayan AI" is for chats that only got the link.
- [Hardware-Rules.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/Hardware-Rules.md): Index of rule sections and when to read each.
- [rules/00-intake.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/rules/00-intake.md): First questions to ask the user (read at project start).

## Rules (open only the section you need)
- [rules/00b-pcb-intake.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/rules/00b-pcb-intake.md): PCB decisions before layout (G0.5), silkscreen questions.
- [rules/03-dfm-cost.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/rules/03-dfm-cost.md): Manufacturer, cost, component and alternates.
- [rules/04-schematic-layout.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/rules/04-schematic-layout.md): Schematic, placement, routing, SI/PI, silkscreen.
- [rules/09-release.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/rules/09-release.md): Revisions, variants, output files.
- [Hardware-Roles.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/Hardware-Roles.md): Roles, workflow, review format.

## Optional
- [rules/05-diff-rf-hs.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/rules/05-diff-rf-hs.md): Only with differential, high-speed or RF.
- [rules/08-aviation.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/rules/08-aviation.md): Only in the Aerospace profile.
- [rules/10-battery.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/rules/10-battery.md): Only with batteries.
- [examples/DR00001-usb-c-led/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/examples/DR00001-usb-c-led/README.md): Small filled example project.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/README.md): Full human-oriented overview (English); [README.tr.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d0ukan/hardware-for-anything/main/README.tr.md) is the Turkish version.
